newsitem.title: POLAND: AGROS 2.4 MLN NEW SHARES CLEARED FOR TRADE.
newsitem.headline: AGROS 2.4 MLN NEW SHARES CLEARED FOR TRADE.

text.p: Polish Securities Commission (KPW) approved Agros Holding SA's new 2.43-million-share issue on Thursday for public trade, KPW said in a statement.
It said 1.24 million shares would be offered to large investors in a subscription between 20 and 21 of March. Small investors will be offered 300,000 shares between March 20 and 26.

The 890,000-share tranche for Agros' current shareholders will be offered in a subscription between March 20 and 26. This tranche will be available for investors holding Argos shares for at least 10 days before the beginning of the subscription.
Agros shareholders will be offered five new shares for each share currently held.
Large investors will be entitled to bid for between 10 and 1.24 million shares and small ones for between 10 and 10,000.
